page_title: GEN 0-3 JUV | Genoa v Juventus 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Andrea Colombo has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+3' Emil Bohinen (Genoa) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
90+3' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' 0 - 3 Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
89' Genoa have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Mattia Perin pulls off a great save to deny Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the top of the net.
85' Substitution. Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) has come on for Alessandro Zanoli.
84' Mattia Bani (Genoa) commits a foul and Andrea Colombo immediately signals a free kick.
84' There's an opportunity for Lior Kasa (Genoa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
84' Emil Bohinen (Genoa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
82' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latched on to a lofted pass inside the box, but his header misses to the right of the target.
80' Lior Kasa (Genoa) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Mattia Perin.
80' Genoa are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
76' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
74' A substitution has been made. Pierre Kalulu is replaced by Nicolo Savona (Juventus).
74' Here is a change. Kenan Yildiz is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
74' The substitution is prepared. Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jonas Rouhi.
73' The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
73' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
69' Substitution. David Ankeye (Genoa) on for Vitinha.
69' Alberto Gilardino has decided to substitute Fabio Miretti and he is replaced by Lior Kasa (Genoa).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alan Matturro (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Honest Ahanor cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
65' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
65' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
62' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) replaces Nicolas Gonzalez.
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Weston McKennie will be replaced by Douglas Luiz (Juventus).
60' Now Genoa have a corner.
58' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Andrea Colombo stops the game and makes a call.
55' 0 - 2 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches on to a killer pass deep inside the box and coolly puts the ball inside the right post!
54' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
53' Some neat passing and movement from Juventus as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
50' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' 0 - 1 Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Pierluigi Gollini.
48' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
47' Koni De Winter (Genoa) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! The referee makes the call - penalty to Juventus!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
43' The corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is hurriedly cleared.
43' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
39' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jonas Rouhi (Juventus) and blew his whistle.
36' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
35' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
34' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance!
32' Emil Bohinen (Genoa) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
29' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
27' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
27' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
26' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make a change. Milan Badelj is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Emil Bohinen (Genoa).
24' Milan Badelj (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
22' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Fabio Miretti (Genoa), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
21' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
20' Genoa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
17' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the left post.
17' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
14' Weston McKennie (Juventus) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
13' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' A spell of possession for Juventus in an attempt to control the game.
9' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
6' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) takes the free kick from the edge of the box but the defensive wall makes the block.
5' Danilo (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andrea Colombo signals. Genoa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
3' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
3' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Genoa will take the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andrea Colombo.
